issue_context.title: Query parameter to return only _formatted object
issue_context.body:
I'm indexing a lot of large text documents. Each can easily be 500-800 KB of text, which I put in a field called full_text. When searching I specify `attributesToCrop=full_text&cropLength=50` and get the result I want in the _formatted object. However, for each hit, I also get the entire full_text back, which is wasteful; 10 hits can result in 5 MB of JSON, whereas it would've been ~40 KB or so without the whole full_text. I can't use `attributesToRetrieve`, because I *do* want the full_text field -- but only the cropped version.

So, it would be great to have the option "just give me the _formatted object and not the non-formatted".

Hello @securisec 

The last version is v0.28.1, I'm not sure what I will explain will work with v0.23.1.
You can set up only the attributes you want to hilhight and crop in `attributesToHighliht` and `attributesToCrop`, and only the attributes you want to retrieve (cropped/highlighted or not) in `atttributesToRetrieve`. Avoid using `*` if you have a lot of data
More info about the search parameters: https://docs.meilisearch.com/reference/api/search.html#search-parameters

For next support we recommend opening (or completing an existing discussion) a discussion in our repo: https://github.com/meilisearch/meilisearch/discussions

Thanks for using Meilisearch 😄

Thank you for the response @curquiza . Here is a screenshot that explains the issue I am having. I updated to 0.28.1 before attempting. In the screenshot, you can see that I am interested in the `data` attribute. But in the response, I get back both `data` and `_formatted.data`. Now imagine data was much larger then this small text. Say it was 500kb. It would send back a ton of data to the client making the request. So in this case, I am using `attributesToRetrieve` and specifying the values, but what I would like to get back in the response is only the `_formatted`, instead of the whole data and `_formatted`.

@securisec you can try to use `attributesToRetrieve: []` (empty) and `attributesToHighlight: ["data"]`
And if you don't want to highlight `data`: `attributesToRetrieve: ["data"]` and `attributesToHighlight: [exhaustive_list_of_highlighted_fields_but_not_data]`

In my case, only `data` is searchable. I have a bunch of other fields in the response (id, title, etc.), but they are all also repeated in `_formatted`, making the response x2 larger.

With the solution above, my response has only `_formatted` -> `data` , but I want other fields too. My final solution was this, and now everything is fitted in `_formatted`, hooray!

```
{
      attributesToHighlight: ["*"],
      attributesToRetrieve: [],
}
```
